Компоненти гри

Усі варіації теми гри (пакет toy, вигляд ui-2.0.0: «Плитка» з палітрою «Чорнильна мʼята»), згенеровані з токенів DTCG: кожен стан окремою клітинкою поруч, зразок «наживо» реагує на мишу, дотик і клавіатуру. Розміри в токенах — пікселі при 1920×1080; масштаб 100 % малює 1 токен-піксель як 1 CSS-піксель.

Застарілі варіації

Ще в пакеті, щоб сцени гри працювали; підуть із наступним мажорним релізом

Ці варіації позначені $deprecated у токенах і deprecated у пакеті. Їх не малюємо: шари-бази прозорі з ui-2.0.0, а заміни інших намальовано вище.

ВаріаціяКласЗамінаЧому
ToyBarAngerзастарілаProgressBarToyBarAngerCalmUse ToyBarAngerCalm (and ToyBarAngerAlarm over the alarm line) since ui-1.3.0. Removed at the next major release.
ToyBarAngerTrackзастарілаPanelContainer–The anger meter is one ProgressBar since ui-1.3.0 (ToyBarAngerCalm): its own background is the track. Removed at the next major release.
ToyBarHealthзастарілаProgressBar–ui-1.3.0 (replaced by the …Calm bar, itself deprecated since ui-2.0.0: health and stamina are pips, ToyPip…). Removed at the next major release.
ToyBarHealthAlarmзастарілаProgressBar–ui-2.0.0: health and stamina are ten segmented pips (ToyPip, ToyPipHealth, ToyPipStamina, ToyPipAlarm in a ToyRowFour); removed at the next major release.
ToyBarHealthCalmзастарілаProgressBar–ui-2.0.0: health and stamina are ten segmented pips (ToyPip, ToyPipHealth, ToyPipStamina, ToyPipAlarm in a ToyRowFour); removed at the next major release.
ToyBarStaminaзастарілаProgressBar–ui-1.3.0 (replaced by the …Calm bar, itself deprecated since ui-2.0.0: health and stamina are pips, ToyPip…). Removed at the next major release.
ToyBarStaminaAlarmзастарілаProgressBar–ui-2.0.0: health and stamina are ten segmented pips (ToyPip, ToyPipHealth, ToyPipStamina, ToyPipAlarm in a ToyRowFour); removed at the next major release.
ToyBarStaminaCalmзастарілаProgressBar–ui-2.0.0: health and stamina are ten segmented pips (ToyPip, ToyPipHealth, ToyPipStamina, ToyPipAlarm in a ToyRowFour); removed at the next major release.
ToyBarTrackзастарілаPanelContainer–The HUD bars are one ProgressBar each since ui-1.3.0 (ToyBarHealthCalm, ToyBarStaminaCalm): its own background is the track. Removed at the next major release.
ToyBaseCardзастарілаPanel–ui-2.0.0: the plain tile has no hard shadow; the game can drop it. Removed at the next major release.
ToyBasePanelзастарілаPanel–ui-2.0.0: the plain tile has no hard shadow; the game can drop it. Removed at the next major release.
ToyBasePrimaryOnDarkзастарілаPanel–ui-1.3.0; clear since ui-2.0.0 (no button has a base layer). Removed at the next major release.
ToyBasePrimaryOnLightзастарілаPanel–ui-1.3.0; clear since ui-2.0.0 (no button has a base layer). Removed at the next major release.
ToyBaseRaisedOnDarkзастарілаPanel–ui-2.0.0: the plain tile has no hard shadow, so no button has a base layer; the game can drop its ToyRaised wrappers. Removed at the next major release.
ToyBaseRaisedOnLightзастарілаPanel–ui-2.0.0: the plain tile has no hard shadow, so no button has a base layer; the game can drop its ToyRaised wrappers. Removed at the next major release.
ToyBaseTitleзастарілаPanel–ui-2.0.0: the plain tile has no hard shadow; the game can drop it. Removed at the next major release.
ToyButtonDangerOnMintзастарілаButtonToyButtonDangerui-2.0.0: no surface is mint any more, so ToyButtonDanger serves everywhere; removed at the next major release.
ToyButtonPrimaryOnMintзастарілаButtonToyButtonPrimaryui-2.0.0: no surface is mint any more, so ToyButtonPrimary serves everywhere; removed at the next major release.
ToyChipNewзастарілаPanelContainerToyChipAlertThe NEW tag is gone (copy round 2): use ToyChipAlert. Removed at the next major release.
ToyChipNewTextзастарілаLabelToyChipAlertTextUse ToyChipAlertText. Removed at the next major release.
ToyHowtoCaptionзастарілаLabel–The how-to cards are wordless (docs/ui-decisions.md): no screen draws a caption, so nothing replaces it. Removed at the next major release.
ToyPlateCountзастарілаPanelContainerToyPlateui-2.1.0: the dead's room shows its return small at the top in one ToyPlate (the engineer, 2026-10-22), so no screen draws the centre countdown plate. Removed at the next major release.
ToyPlateHeadзастарілаPanelContainerToyPlateui-2.1.0: the room's name sits in the same top ToyPlate as the return, so the head plate is gone. Removed at the next major release.
ToyPlateHeadTextзастарілаLabelToyKickerui-2.1.0: the room's name is the top tile's head (ToyKicker). Removed at the next major release.
